composition_label: Document review -> Ticket triage & routing -> Sentiment & prioritization | Healthcare

construction.implementation_origin: New deterministic reference implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Strict fields: schema_version, synthetic, settings, records. Each record contains id, patient, clinical_note, prior_authorization.
shared_schema.entities: Synthetic Patient with diagnosis and lab arrays; DocumentReference carrying clinical note text; draft Claim carrying prior authorization evidence. FHIR-style only.
shared_schema.output: Same version, synthetic flag, settings, and records envelope plus phase/status/disclaimer. Each output record wraps the unchanged payload, safety flags, cumulative stages, and audit.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate function checks external input and each stage boundary, strict fields, bounded types, unique IDs, synthetic assertions, identifier patterns, safety flags, deterministic derived results and audit chain.
shared_schema.privacy: Only pre-de-identified synthetic data accepted. Patient identifiers are allowlisted synthetic IDs; names, birth dates, identifier and address fields are forbidden. Free-text pattern rejection illustrates safeguards but cannot establish HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination.

cross_stage_handoffs: Review checks all requirement terms against traceable note, authorization evidence, diagnosis and lab source paths; missing terms become explicit gap IDs.
Triage validates review output, consumes gaps and gap descriptions, applies configured first-match category/owner routing, and assigns administrative priority.
Sentiment validates triage output, propagates ticket, owner and gaps, scores clinical-note wording and combines the administrative severity with bounded gap and negativity bonuses.

behavior.review: All evidence terms required; whole normalized token phrases; evidence_found is not proof of clinical truth, approval or certification.
behavior.routing: First matching configured rule, otherwise accountable fallback; urgent keyword overrides high gap priority and normal no-gap priority.
behavior.sentiment: Positive lexicon: helpful, clear, satisfied, excellent, thanks. Negative: delay, delayed, frustrated, confusing, denied, poor. Immediate not/no/never flips weight. Score is sum divided by matched token count, or zero.
behavior.prioritization: Normal/high/urgent administrative severity bases 10/50/80 plus min(10, 2*gap_count) plus round(10*max(0,-sentiment)). Positive sentiment never reduces urgency. No medical severity inference.
behavior.audit: Every immutable record construction or stage addition is logged, including changed paths and SHA-256 before/after snapshots. Sequence numbers replace wall-clock timestamps for reproducibility. Hashes support consistency checking, not cryptographic authenticity.
behavior.human_control: Human review always true; autonomous clinical decision always false; draft authorization remains unchanged.
behavior.errors: JSON error response and exit 2 for file/validation errors; no raw data or file paths reflected. Successful CLI prints one JSON object and exits 0.

excluded: Complete HIPAA de-identification or compliance certification
Clinical diagnosis, advice, treatment or medical urgency decisions
External networks, dependencies, LLMs or providers

coverage: Cross-stage gap, owner and ticket propagation
